name: source-verifier-userscript
description: A userscript which shows post source information for e621 staff.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run webpack:dev && npm run clean:tmp && npm run inject-header
scripts.build:prod: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run webpack:prod && npm run clean:tmp && npm run inject-header
scripts.clean: npm run clean:dist && npm run clean:tmp
scripts.postinstall: cd src && mkdir shared && cd shared && git init && git remote add -f origin https://github.com/Tarrgon/source-verifier.git && git config core.sparsecheckout true && git sparse-checkout set --no-cone "shared" && git pull --depth=1 origin master && npx copyfiles "./**" ../ && npx rimraf shared
